build_Hmmsearch_wrapper: build a Python wrapper for the hmmsearch binary to search profile HMMs against a sequence database
query_Hmmsearch_with_msa: query the hmmsearch database using a Stockholm format MSA to find matching sequences
query_Hmmsearch_with_hmm: query the hmmsearch database using a prebuilt HMM profile string to retrieve aligned sequences
get_template_hits_Hmmsearch: get parsed template hits from raw hmmsearch output by converting Stockholm to A3M format
review_Hmmsearch_class: review the Hmmsearch class initialization and default E-value flags for hmmsearch configuration
